about: Sprout's frozen recipe, gates and selection rules (GATES.md explains each). train.py and evaluate.py read them from here. Change this file only before the real run, in a commit of its own; never after the run has started.

recipe_notes.optimizer: AdamW over every parameter, betas (0.9, 0.99), one weight decay for all
recipe_notes.schedule: linear warm-up for `warmup` steps, then a cosine to floor x lr at the last step
recipe_notes.loss: Phyll's: cross-entropy over every non-pad target (model.py)

gates.measures: whole-chat loss before training (B-val + A-val), run seed and seeds 1-5, within 0.05 of ln 46
b_val[0] alone, constant lr 3e-3, no weight decay: completed updates until the loss is below 0.01 (none: fails)
the eight frozen chats, as gate 1: completed updates until within 0.02 of their prefix-entropy floor
the full run, evaluation included, on the recipe's 6 CPU threads
validation whole-chat loss on identical targets, against the smoothed character bigram (counts from the run's stream, add-k chosen on validation)
greedy exact match on B-test (strict raw ids, at most 24 new ids)
greedy exact match on A-train, the 216 trained phrasings
the look-up head zeroed at the answer-writing position only: B-test first-character accuracy drops by 40 points or more
6a's drop exceeds the same cut on the control head (the most damaging other head of its layer) by 20 points or more

selection.on: validation only (B-val; the head on B-val)
selection.checkpoint: the highest B-val greedy exact match; ties to the lower B-val answer-only loss, then to the earlier step (evaluations at step 0, every 100 steps and the last)
selection.head: the narrated look-up head: the largest mean attention share on the asked note's value characters, at the position that writes the answer's first character, on B-val; ties to the lower layer, then the lower head
selection.control: the other head (or heads) of the look-up head's layer; with more than one, the most damaging under the same position-limited cut

test_sets.b_test: confirmatory: fresh held-out families (split revision 3), read once, after the checkpoint and head are frozen
test_sets.b_paired: confirmatory: fresh held-out families; it overlaps b_test's families by design
test_sets.a_test: descriptive only, never gated: these new-wording questions were read by earlier prototypes (provisional/TEST-EXPOSURE.md)

retry: none: one confirmation run; a failed gate is reported, never re-run for a pass
